rca_of_the_issue: ForcedAdInterstitial previously scheduled a MAX_VIEW_SECONDS=20 hard-cap timeout for all platforms. On Android APK the AdMob rewarded video runs 30-60s; when the 20s timer fired first it set closedRef.current=true and skipped onAdCompleted, then when AdMob's real completion fired the `if (!closedRef.current)` guard blocked the collect path. Fix v1.4.4 early-returns from the hard-cap useEffect when Capacitor.isNativePlatform() && !nativeFallback so the SDK drives completion; parent MiningWidget safety net extended from 25s to 60s so it does not false-fire on legit long ads.
